title: Boruto: Naruto Next Generations
label: Quick read (from summaries)
premise: A sequel to Naruto, the series follows Boruto, son of the village leader Naruto, as he trains as a ninja and resents his father's absence. When alien Otsutsuki beings and the Kara organization threaten the world, Boruto, marked with a mysterious 'Karma' seal, forms a rivalry with Kawaki, a boy taken in by his family. A later part follows an older Boruto protecting his village while former allies see him as an enemy.
life_message: It holds up family bonds, earning one's own strength and protecting others even when misunderstood.
